name: XI · Justice
imagery: A crowned figure in red robes sits between two grey pillars, holding an upright double-edged sword in the right hand and golden scales in the left, with a purple veil hung behind. The sword cuts cleanly to the truth, the scales weigh every action with impartial care, and one white shoe peeking from beneath the robe hints that judgement must be put into action.
meaning: Justice is the card of honest reckoning: what you have set in motion returns to you, and the truth of a situation is coming into the light. It asks you to weigh matters with a clear head and a fair heart, taking responsibility for your own part without self-punishment. Contracts, agreements and decisions are favoured when you act with integrity and full information. In the craft, this is karmic balance made visible, the reminder that every spell, word and choice ripples outward. Stand in your truth, speak it plainly, and let the scales settle where they rightly fall.
numerology: Eleven, the master number of illumination; reduced to two, it speaks of balance between opposing forces and the weighing of choices.
affirmation: I act with integrity, and I trust the truth to bring balance.

ctx.past: A decision, agreement or reckoning in your past set the terms you are living with now. You may have reaped exactly what was sown, for better or worse, and that outcome taught you how cause and effect really work in your life. Honour what that fair or hard lesson gave you.
ctx.present: Right now the scales are being weighed. The heart of this matter is honesty: what is true, what is fair, and what each person is genuinely responsible for. Gather the facts, lay them out clearly, and choose the path you could defend with a calm conscience.
ctx.future: A fair resolution is coming, shaped by the choices you make between now and then. Agreements, formal decisions or long-awaited answers are likely to settle according to merit. Keep acting with integrity and you can trust the outcome to reflect the truth rather than chance.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle here is rigid judgement or an imbalance you have been tolerating. You may be holding yourself or someone else to an impossible standard, or avoiding a truth that would tip the scales. Fairness without compassion becomes cold; compassion without honesty becomes avoidance. Find the true middle.
ctx.advice: Take the sword in hand and cut through the excuses, including your own. Write down the facts, own your share, and make the decision that aligns with your values even if it is not the easiest. Sign nothing unclear, keep promises precise, and speak plainly.
ctx.self: You see yourself as someone who values fairness and wants to do the right thing. You may be weighing your own past choices quite carefully at the moment. Let that self-assessment be honest but kind; accountability is about growth, not punishment.
ctx.others: Those around you are looking for fairness and clear answers, and some may see you as the one who will judge impartially. An official process, a mediator or a principled person may be influencing events. Expect people to respond to what you actually do rather than what you intend.
ctx.hopes: You long for things to finally be made right, for effort to be recognised and wrongs acknowledged. You may also fear being judged or found wanting. Both feelings point to the same need: to know that the world, and you, can be trusted to be fair.
ctx.love: In love, Justice asks for an equal partnership where both people give and receive in balance. Honest conversations about expectations, commitments and fairness strengthen the bond. If something has felt lopsided, now is the time to name it calmly and renegotiate the terms of your connection.
ctx.work: At work and in money matters, contracts, negotiations and formal decisions are highlighted. Read the fine print, keep good records, and deal transparently. Rewards are likely to be proportional to effort, so make sure your contribution is visible and your agreements are clear and documented.
ctx.spirit: Your guides speak of karmic balance and the quiet law that what you send out returns. Spirit is asking you to align your outer actions with your inner truth. Light a candle before the scales of your own heart and ask what would be just for everyone involved.
ctx.release: Let go of the need to keep score, or of a grudge that insists the universe owes you. Release dishonest bargains, half-truths and agreements that no longer serve both sides. Laying down this weight restores your own balance more surely than any verdict could.
ctx.shadow: Beneath the surface you may be judging yourself harshly for something you have never fully forgiven. Or a hidden truth is quietly tilting events, waiting to be acknowledged. Look where you avoid looking; the sword of clarity is gentler than the fear of it.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a question of fairness, responsibility or consequence. Something was decided, promised or done, and everything else has grown from that. Understanding the original choice clearly will show you how to set things right now.
ctx.gift: Your gift is clear sight and a strong moral compass. You can see through confusion to what is truly fair, and others trust you for it. Use this discernment to make a clean decision, mediate a dispute, or finally set a healthy boundary.

name: XII · The Hanged Man
imagery: A man hangs upside down by one foot from a living T-shaped tree, his free leg bent behind to form a cross, hands tucked behind his back and a radiant halo around his calm face. Waite stressed that his expression is one of deep entrancement, not suffering: the living wood speaks of growth, the halo of illumination, and the inverted posture of seeing the world from an entirely new angle.
meaning: The Hanged Man invites a sacred pause. Progress may seem stalled, but this suspension is fertile, offering insight you could never reach while rushing forward. By surrendering the need to control, you open to a radically different perspective on your situation. Sometimes a small sacrifice now, of time, comfort or an old belief, buys a far greater wisdom. Hang in the in-between with trust, like a witch in trance between worlds, and let the answer turn itself the right way up.
numerology: Twelve, the completion of a cycle of growth (as in twelve months or signs); reduced to three, it hints at the creative insight born from stillness.
affirmation: I pause with trust, and new wisdom reveals itself to me.

ctx.past: In the past you went through a period of waiting, limbo or sacrifice that felt like nothing was moving. In hindsight, that suspension changed how you see things. The perspective you gained then is quietly guiding the choices you are making now.
ctx.present: You are in a deliberate pause, whether you chose it or not. Pushing harder will not help; looking differently will. Let yourself be still, turn the problem upside down, and notice what becomes visible when you stop trying to force an outcome.
ctx.future: A time of stillness or delay is ahead, and it will bring a revelation if you allow it. What looks like being stuck will become an awakening, a shift in how you understand your circumstances. Plan for patience rather than speed.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is endless waiting or martyrdom. You may be sacrificing yourself without purpose, or stalling a decision in the hope that it will make itself. Surrender is wise; drifting is not. Ask what this pause is actually for and what you are avoiding.
ctx.advice: Stop, breathe and let go of the grip. Meditate, journal, or simply sleep on it before acting. Try deliberately adopting the opposite viewpoint from your usual one. Give up a small comfort or habit if it frees space for a bigger insight.
ctx.self: You may feel suspended, out of step with everyone else, or as though life is on hold. That is not failure; it is a chrysalis. You are learning to trust your own inner timing and to be at peace without immediate answers.
ctx.others: People around you may see you as unconventional or as someone who is waiting, and some may not understand your choices. Alternatively, others in the situation are themselves in limbo, unable to commit. Give everyone, including yourself, a little more time.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a breakthrough insight that will make sense of everything, and perhaps fear that you are wasting time or losing out. Both point to the value of letting go. The clarity you desire arrives most easily when you stop chasing it.
ctx.love: In love, a relationship may be in a holding pattern, or you are being asked to see your partner or your own needs from a new angle. Do not force declarations right now. Gentle surrender, patience and a willingness to give without keeping score will deepen understanding.
ctx.work: Career or projects may be on pause, waiting on others or on circumstances outside your control. Use this time to rethink strategy rather than spinning wheels. A creative approach that turns conventional wisdom upside down could be exactly what moves things forward later.
ctx.spirit: Spirit calls you into trance and receptivity. This is a powerful time for divination, dreamwork and meditation, for hanging between the worlds and listening. Your guides speak most clearly when you surrender the need to understand everything immediately.
ctx.release: Let go of control, urgency and the belief that you must always be doing something. Release a fixed viewpoint you have outgrown. When you stop resisting the pause, the tension drains away and the way forward reveals itself.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath this situation may be a habit of self-sacrifice or passive waiting that you have not acknowledged. You might be clinging to suffering as proof of virtue. Look at where you put yourself last and ask whether it truly serves anyone.
ctx.foundation: At the core of this matter is a need to see differently. The situation grew from a deadlock, a sacrifice, or a perspective that has become stuck. Shift your viewpoint at the root and the whole structure above it will rearrange itself.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to find wisdom in stillness. Where others panic at delay, you can turn it into insight. Your willingness to see things from unusual angles is a quiet superpower that will unlock this situation.

name: XIII · Death
imagery: A skeleton in black armour rides a white horse, carrying a black banner emblazoned with a white five-petalled rose, while a king lies fallen and a bishop, a maiden and a child react before him. In the distance the sun rises between two towers over a flowing river. Death comes to all equally, yet the mystic rose and the rising sun promise that every ending carries the seed of renewal.
meaning: Death is the card of transformation, not literal doom. A chapter is closing, and something must be cleared away so that new life can take root. Resisting this change only prolongs discomfort, while accepting it allows a natural, even liberating, transition. Like autumn leaves feeding the soil, what falls away now nourishes what comes next. Honour the ending, grieve what needs grieving, and turn your face toward the sunrise on the horizon.
numerology: Thirteen, the number beyond the completed cycle of twelve; reduced to four, it signals the rebuilding of new foundations after an ending.
affirmation: I release what has ended and welcome the life that follows.

ctx.past: A significant ending or transformation in your past cleared the ground you now stand on. Something was lost or left behind, and it changed you. You are already living in the new life that ending made possible, even if part of you still mourns it.
ctx.present: You are in the midst of a major transition. Something is drawing to a natural close, and the more gracefully you allow it, the smoother the passage. This is not punishment; it is the rhythm of life asking you to shed an old skin.
ctx.future: A chapter will close and a new one begin. The change ahead is transformative rather than catastrophic: a door shutting so another can open. Prepare by loosening your grip on what has run its course, and you will move through it with dignity.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is resistance to change. You may be clinging to a situation, identity or relationship that has already ended in spirit. The longer you hold on, the heavier it becomes. Let the old form go and trust that what is essential will survive the passage.
ctx.advice: Make a clean ending. Close the account, finish the conversation, clear the space, or hold a ritual to mark the transition. Grieve honestly, then turn deliberately toward the rising sun. Clearing out is an act of faith in what is coming.
ctx.self: You are changing deeply, perhaps in ways others have not yet noticed. An old version of you is passing away. Be patient with the in-between feeling; you are not lost, you are becoming someone new.
ctx.others: People around you may be going through endings of their own, or they may see you as someone in the middle of a big life change. Some relationships or influences are naturally falling away. Allow others their own transitions without trying to hold them in place.
ctx.hopes: You may fear endings and loss, yet secretly long for a fresh start. Both feelings live in this card. The change you dread and the renewal you desire are the same doorway, seen from different sides.
ctx.love: In love, a relationship is transforming: an old pattern, phase or dynamic is ending. For some, this may mean a bond completing its natural course; for others, it means the relationship being reborn on deeper terms. Either way, honesty about what has changed will guide you.
ctx.work: In work and money, a role, project or way of earning is concluding. Restructuring, career change or closing one venture to open another are all possible. Treat this as a clearing, and look for where your energy is being called next rather than mourning what is complete.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks of the great cycle of death and rebirth, the wisdom of the ancestors and of Samhain. Your guides are helping you shed what no longer belongs to your soul's path. Honour your dead, honour your past selves, and trust the regenerative power of endings.
ctx.release: This is the ultimate card of release. Let go fully and finally of what has ended: the relationship, habit, identity or hope that has already died in spirit. Bury it with love and ceremony, and let the ground lie fallow for new seeds.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath the surface may be a fear of change so deep it shapes your choices without your noticing. Or an ending has already happened that you have not consciously admitted. Bringing it into the light allows the transformation to complete.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is an ending, a loss or a deep transformation that changed everything that followed. Understanding and accepting that turning point allows you to build consciously on what remains instead of living in its shadow.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the power to transform. You know, in your bones, how to let things die and rise again. This resilience lets you clear what is stagnant and begin anew, offering a fresh beginning to yourself and others.

name: XIV · Temperance
imagery: A winged angel with a solar disc on the brow and a triangle within a square on the chest pours water between two cups, one foot on land and one in a pool. Irises bloom beside the water and a path leads to a golden crown glowing between distant mountains. The flowing water shows the alchemy of blending opposites, the stance shows balance between conscious and unconscious, and the path promises that patient integration leads to the highest goal.
meaning: Temperance is the alchemist's card, the patient art of blending opposing elements into something greater. It asks for moderation, steadiness and the middle way rather than extremes. Healing happens here, slowly and surely, as you find the right mixture of rest and effort, giving and receiving. Things are coming together in their own time, so trust the process rather than forcing results. Like a careful brew in the cauldron, your life becomes potent through balance and the right proportions.
numerology: Fourteen, reduced to five, turns the restlessness of change into harmony; it is the number of conscious adjustment and integration.
affirmation: I blend all parts of my life with patience, and I find my perfect balance.

ctx.past: In the past you learned the value of moderation and patience, perhaps by recovering from excess or healing slowly from a difficult time. That period of steady integration created stability. The balance you found then is a resource you can draw on again now.
ctx.present: Right now you are being asked to find the middle path. Something needs gentle blending: two people, two plans, two sides of yourself. Move slowly, adjust the mixture as you go, and trust that harmony is forming even if progress feels gradual.
ctx.future: Things will come together harmoniously over time. Healing, reconciliation and a more balanced way of living lie ahead, provided you keep your patience. The outcome is not a sudden win but a lasting, well-mixed result that truly holds.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is imbalance or impatience. You may be swinging between extremes, overdoing one area of life while neglecting another, or wanting the alchemy to finish before it has had time to work. Watch for excess and gently bring yourself back to centre.
ctx.advice: Practise moderation and combine rather than choose. Take a little from both options, schedule rest alongside effort, and approach conflict as a mediator. Make small, steady adjustments instead of dramatic overhauls. Brew slowly; the potion is nearly ready.
ctx.self: You are calm, adaptable and good at seeing both sides. You may be quietly integrating different parts of your identity into a more whole sense of self. Honour the healer and the alchemist in you, the one who knows how to make things work together.
ctx.others: Others see you as a steady, balancing presence, perhaps a peacemaker. A patient person or a cooperative environment may be supporting you. Collaboration and mutual compromise will work better than competition in this situation, so seek allies rather than rivals.
ctx.hopes: You long for peace, balance and a life that feels integrated rather than pulled in all directions. You may fear that harmony is impossible amid competing demands. It is possible; it simply grows slowly, drop by drop.
ctx.love: In love, Temperance blesses compatibility and the gentle blending of two lives. Relationships deepen through patience, compromise and mutual care. Healing after conflict is well-starred, and couples find a sweet rhythm when neither person dominates.
ctx.work: In work and finances, steady, balanced effort pays off. Avoid all-or-nothing gambles and instead combine skills, resources or teams creatively. Collaborative projects, mediation and long-term planning flourish. Your craft improves through patient refinement rather than rushing.
ctx.spirit: Your guides, perhaps an angelic or healing presence, are helping you integrate your spiritual practice with daily life. This is alchemy in its truest sense: turning lead to gold within. Rituals of blending, such as brewing, tea magic or water work, are especially potent now.
ctx.release: Let go of extremes and all-or-nothing thinking. Release habits of excess, whether in work, food, worry or self-criticism. Releasing the need for instant results allows the deeper healing work to unfold at its natural pace.
ctx.shadow: Beneath the surface may lie a part of yourself you keep separate, refusing to blend it with the rest of your life. Or an unacknowledged excess is quietly unbalancing everything. Gently invite that hidden piece into the mixture.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this matter is a need for balance and integration. The situation grew from things being out of proportion, or from two forces that have not yet learned to work together. Restoring harmony at this level will steady everything built upon it.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the alchemist's touch: patience, moderation and the ability to harmonise opposites. You can heal, mediate and combine resources into something greater. This steady, patient grace is exactly what the situation needs from you right now.

name: XV · The Devil
imagery: A horned, bat-winged figure crouches on a black pedestal, one hand raised and the other holding a downward torch, with an inverted pentagram on the brow. Before him stand a naked man and woman, chained loosely at the neck and sprouting small horns and tails. The chains are loose enough to lift off: the card mirrors The Lovers and shows how desire, fear and materialism bind us only as long as we believe we cannot walk free.
meaning: The Devil reveals where you are bound: by a habit, fear, unhealthy attachment or the pull of material comfort. It is not about evil but about the shadow parts of yourself that gain power when unexamined. The chains in the image are loose, which means freedom is available the moment you recognise your own complicity. This card also honours raw desire, earthy pleasure and ambition, as long as you are choosing them rather than being ruled by them. Look your shadow in the eye, name what controls you, and reclaim your power.
numerology: Fifteen, reduced to six, shows the dark mirror of the Lovers: choice and desire bound by attachment rather than freed by love.
affirmation: I name what binds me, and I choose my own freedom.

ctx.past: In the past you were caught in a pattern of attachment, temptation or control, perhaps a relationship, habit or situation that held you more tightly than you realised. Its influence still echoes. Recognising how you were bound then helps you notice similar hooks now.
ctx.present: Right now something has a grip on you: a craving, fear, obligation or dynamic that feels inescapable. Look closely and you will see the chain is loose. The heart of the matter is admitting what you are attached to and remembering that you have a choice.
ctx.future: Temptation or a binding situation may arise. Go in with eyes open: pleasure and ambition are not wrong, but be wary of agreements, indulgences or relationships that cost more than they give. Awareness now keeps you free later.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is an attachment or compulsion that keeps you stuck, whether to money, a person, a substance, perfectionism or fear. You may be giving away power by believing you have no options. The challenge is to see the chain clearly and lift it off.
ctx.advice: Be brutally honest about what controls you. Name the habit or dynamic, then take one concrete step toward freedom, however small. Seek support if needed. Shadow work, journalling and cord-cutting rituals are powerful allies now.
ctx.self: You may feel trapped or ruled by desires you are not proud of, or you may be discovering a wilder, more instinctive side of yourself. Neither makes you bad. Accepting your shadow without shame is the first step to mastering it.
ctx.others: Someone around you may be manipulative, possessive or materialistic, or a group dynamic is encouraging unhealthy habits. Others might also see you as intense or seductive. Notice where outside influences pull you away from your own values.
ctx.hopes: You may secretly crave something forbidden, or fear being trapped and losing control. Both reflect a struggle between desire and freedom. Ask yourself what you truly want beneath the craving, and whether it can be met in a way that liberates you.
ctx.love: In love, this card points to powerful attraction, passion and chemistry, but also possessiveness, codependence or staying out of fear. Examine whether the bond feels freely chosen. Healthy desire is a gift; obsession and control are chains to be lifted.
ctx.work: In work and money, beware of golden handcuffs, debt, overwork or deals that compromise your values. Ambition is powerful here, but make sure it serves you rather than consuming you. Read terms carefully and check what you are really trading for security.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is inviting you into shadow work. Your guides want you to meet the parts of yourself you usually hide, not to condemn them but to integrate them. There is great power in the dark when it is faced with honesty and compassion.
ctx.release: Let go of the attachment, habit or relationship that keeps you in chains. Cut the cords, literally or ritually, and reclaim your energy. Release shame too; it only tightens the bonds. You are freer than you think.
ctx.shadow: This is the shadow card itself. A hidden compulsion, buried resentment or unacknowledged desire may be steering your choices. Bringing it into the light strips it of power and turns it into usable energy and self-knowledge.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies an attachment, fear or material pressure that has shaped everything above it. Something is being held onto out of habit or anxiety. Address that core bond and the whole situation can begin to loosen.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the courage to face your shadow and the earthy, grounded power of desire and ambition. You understand temptation from the inside, which makes you wise and non-judgemental. Channelled consciously, this energy fuels passion and achievement.

name: XVI · The Tower
imagery: A tall grey tower on a rocky peak is struck by lightning, its golden crown blasted off as flames burst from the windows and two figures fall headlong through the dark sky. Twenty-two yod-shaped drops of fire scatter around them. The tower is a structure built on false foundations, the lightning is a flash of divine truth, and the falling crown shows ego and illusion being toppled to make way for something real.
meaning: The Tower brings sudden, often unexpected change that shakes loose what was built on shaky ground. While it can feel disruptive, its lightning is ultimately liberating: illusions crumble, truth is revealed, and you are freed from structures that could never have held. Rather than fearing the fall, recognise that what remains standing afterwards is authentic and strong. This is the card of awakening, of the flash of insight that changes everything. Ride the storm with courage, and rebuild on bedrock.
numerology: Sixteen, reduced to seven, is the number of spiritual testing and the breaking open of false certainty to reveal deeper truth.
affirmation: I welcome the truth that sets me free, and I rebuild on solid ground.

ctx.past: A sudden upheaval in your past shattered something you once relied on. Though painful, it cleared away what was false and awakened you to a truth. You are still rebuilding from that moment, and you are stronger and wiser because of it.
ctx.present: Right now something is shaking or collapsing. A revelation, unexpected event or long-suppressed truth is breaking through. Do not cling to what is falling; step aside and let the lightning do its work. What remains will be real.
ctx.future: A sudden change or revelation is on the horizon. It may arrive abruptly and turn your plans upside down, but it will free you from something that could not last. Prepare by being honest now; the less you build on illusion, the gentler the shake-up.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is a structure, belief or arrangement built on a weak foundation. You may be bracing against inevitable change, which only increases the force of its arrival. The challenge is to stop propping up what is cracking and to face the truth directly.
ctx.advice: Let it fall. Do not waste energy patching walls that are already crumbling. Tell the truth, break the pattern, and welcome the breakthrough even if it feels dramatic. After the dust settles, rebuild deliberately on solid values.
ctx.self: You may feel shaken, as though your sense of who you are has been struck by lightning. This is an awakening, not a destruction of your worth. False self-images are falling away to reveal someone more authentic and resilient.
ctx.others: Events outside your control, or other people's revelations and choices, may be causing disruption. Others might see you in the middle of a dramatic change. Remember that chaos in your environment does not define your inner core.
ctx.hopes: You may fear sudden loss or collapse, or you may secretly hope that something will finally blow open a stuck situation. Both point to a deep wish for change that you cannot quite initiate yourself. The Tower brings exactly that, for good reason.
ctx.love: In love, a sudden revelation or turning point is likely. Hidden truths may surface, or a relationship may break through a crisis into greater honesty. Whatever happens, the Tower clears away pretence so that authentic connection becomes possible.
ctx.work: In work and finances, expect unexpected shifts: a restructuring, a sudden opportunity, or the collapse of a plan that was never sound. Have contingencies, but also see the opening. Breakthrough ideas often arrive in a flash during upheaval.
ctx.spirit: Spirit sends a lightning bolt of awakening. Your guides may be shaking you free of spiritual complacency or outworn beliefs. Expect sudden insights, synchronicities or a dramatic shift in your practice that brings you closer to raw truth.
ctx.release: Release the structures that no longer hold: illusions, false securities, pretence and ego attachments. Let the crown fall. Releasing now, voluntarily, is far easier than having it torn away later. Freedom lies on the other side.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath the surface may be a suppressed truth or pressure building toward release. Something you have refused to see is straining the foundations. Acknowledging it consciously can transform a crash into a controlled demolition.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies an unstable foundation or a moment of sudden rupture. Something was built on illusion or was abruptly broken. Understanding that original crack allows you to rebuild on bedrock this time.
ctx.gift: Your gift is resilience and the capacity for breakthrough. You can survive upheaval and see the truth that others miss. The lightning that shakes you also illuminates, giving you courage to dismantle what is false and build what is real.

name: XVII · The Star
imagery: A naked woman kneels by a pool beneath a great eight-pointed golden star and seven smaller white stars, pouring water from one jug into the pool and from the other onto the land, where it runs in five streams. On a tree behind her perches an ibis, sacred to Thoth. Her nakedness speaks of vulnerability and truth, the jugs of replenishing both the subconscious and the material world, and the stars and ibis of divine guidance and wisdom renewed.
meaning: After the storm of the Tower comes the Star, a quiet promise that hope is real and healing has begun. This card brings renewal of faith, gentle inspiration and the feeling of being guided by something larger than yourself. It invites you to be open and authentic, pouring your gifts freely into the world while replenishing your own well. Dreams that seemed far away come back into view. Make a wish beneath the night sky; the universe is listening.
numerology: Seventeen, reduced to eight, signals regeneration and the steady flow of energy restored after trial.
affirmation: I am guided by hope, and healing flows through me.

ctx.past: In the past you came through a difficult time and found hope again. A period of healing, inspiration or renewed faith restored you. That light is still with you, a reminder that you have recovered before and can again.
ctx.present: Right now healing and hope are flowing back into your life. After strain or upheaval, you are being offered calm, inspiration and the chance to begin again. Allow yourself to rest, to dream, and to trust that you are on the right path.
ctx.future: A hopeful, healing phase lies ahead. Wishes have a real chance of fulfilment, and you will feel more peaceful and guided. Keep your vision bright and your heart open; the Star promises that better days are genuinely coming.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle may be losing faith or keeping your hopes so distant that they never touch the ground. You might be giving endlessly without refilling your own jug. Let hope become practical, and remember to receive as well as pour.
ctx.advice: Reconnect with your dreams and let yourself hope again. Spend time under the night sky, by water, or in quiet meditation. Share your gifts generously and authentically, without hiding. Make a wish with intention and take one small step toward it.
ctx.self: You are seeing yourself with gentler, more hopeful eyes. There is an authentic, unguarded quality to you right now. Trust your inner light and stop shrinking from being seen; you are more radiant and inspiring than you realise.
ctx.others: Others see you as a source of calm and inspiration, perhaps a healer or guiding light. Supportive people and a hopeful atmosphere surround you. Help may come from a mentor, a community or a kind stranger who restores your faith.
ctx.hopes: You deeply hope for healing, peace and the fulfilment of a cherished dream. Perhaps you fear hoping too much in case you are disappointed. The Star reassures you that this hope is well-founded and worth holding onto.
ctx.love: In love, the Star brings healing, sincerity and spiritual connection. Old wounds may soften, and relationships grow more open and trusting. For those seeking love, staying true to your authentic self attracts a partner who sees your light.
ctx.work: In work and creative craft, inspiration flows freely. This is an excellent time for visionary projects, creative work, and long-term goals. Finances improve gradually as confidence returns. Let your unique gifts shine; they are your best career asset now.
ctx.spirit: Your guides are very close, sending reassurance and starlight. This is a blessed time for star magic, wish spells, water rituals and connecting with celestial energies. You are being reminded that you are cared for and divinely guided.
ctx.release: Release despair, cynicism and the belief that things will never improve. Let go of the habit of hiding your true self. Pour out the old water and let fresh, clear hope fill your jug instead.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath the surface may be a hope you have not dared to admit, even to yourself. Or a quiet despair you have been covering with busyness. Gently uncover it; your secret dream may be the very guiding star you need.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is hope and the longing for healing. Beneath everything lies a deep faith, perhaps wounded but not lost. Building on that foundation of trust and renewal will steady whatever rises from it.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to heal and inspire. You carry an inner light that restores hope in yourself and others. This serenity and vision are a blessing to everyone around you and a powerful source of guidance now.

name: XVIII · The Moon
imagery: A full moon with a solemn face hangs between two towers, shedding yod-shaped drops of dew over a winding path. A dog and a wolf howl at it, while a crayfish crawls up from a pool toward the path that leads into distant mountains. The dog and wolf are tame and wild instincts, the crayfish is the unconscious stirring into awareness, and the shifting moonlight shows a world where things are not quite as they seem.
meaning: The Moon leads you into the realm of dreams, intuition and the unconscious, where shapes shift and certainty dissolves. Things may be unclear or deceptive right now, so avoid making firm decisions based on surface appearances. This card also opens psychic channels: dreams, visions and instinct carry important messages. Fears may loom larger in the half-light than they are in reality. Walk the moonlit path slowly, trust your inner knowing, and let the truth emerge in its own time.
numerology: Eighteen, reduced to nine, is the number of deep inner wisdom gained by journeying through the unknown.
affirmation: I trust my intuition to guide me through the mystery.

ctx.past: In the past you moved through a period of confusion, illusion or fear, when things were not as they seemed. You may have been deceived, or deceived yourself. That journey through the dark deepened your intuition and taught you to read beneath appearances.
ctx.present: Right now the path is lit only by moonlight. Things are unclear, emotions are heightened, and not all the facts are visible. Trust your instincts, pay attention to dreams, and be cautious about drawing final conclusions until more is revealed.
ctx.future: A period of uncertainty or heightened intuition is approaching. You may face confusing circumstances or hidden information. Rather than fear the unknown, prepare to navigate by feeling. Truth will surface gradually, and your psychic sense will be strong.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is illusion, anxiety or self-deception. Fears may be exaggerated in the dark, or someone may not be telling the whole truth. The challenge is to separate genuine intuition from worry and projection, and to wait for clearer light before acting.
ctx.advice: Slow down and trust your gut. Keep a dream journal, meditate, or work with lunar rituals. Do not make major commitments based on incomplete information. Ask questions, verify facts, and let your intuition and logic work together.
ctx.self: You are deeply intuitive right now, perhaps feeling more sensitive, dreamy or uncertain than usual. Parts of yourself you do not fully understand are surfacing. Be gentle; you are getting to know the wild, mysterious depths of your own psyche.
ctx.others: Others may be hard to read, or the environment feels murky and uncertain. Someone may be hiding something or projecting their own fears onto you. Keep your boundaries and rely on your own perceptions rather than gossip.
ctx.hopes: You may hope for clarity and fear being deceived or lost. Underneath may lie a wish to trust your intuition more fully. The Moon says your instincts are valid; it is the fear, not the mystery, that distorts the picture.
ctx.love: In love, emotions run deep and romantic but uncertain. There may be unspoken feelings, idealisation or misunderstandings. Communicate honestly, avoid assumptions, and give the relationship time to reveal its true nature in the light of day.
ctx.work: In work and finances, information may be incomplete or misleading. Double-check details, contracts and promises before committing. However, creative and intuitive work thrives under this card: art, writing, divination and dream-inspired projects are richly supported.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through dreams, symbols and the language of the unconscious. This is a potent time for moon magic, scrying, divination and journeying. Your guides may appear in strange, poetic forms; trust what you sense even if you cannot yet explain it.
ctx.release: Release irrational fears and the anxious stories your mind tells in the dark. Let go of illusions about people or situations that you have been clinging to. Clearing the fog allows your true intuition to shine through more clearly.
ctx.shadow: Hidden fears, buried memories or unconscious patterns are rising, like the crayfish from the pool. Something beneath your awareness is shaping your responses. Welcome it gently; facing what lurks in the shadows dissolves its power.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies uncertainty, illusion or deep emotional undercurrents. Something unseen or misunderstood has shaped everything that grew from it. Bringing it gently into awareness, through reflection or dreamwork, will help steady the whole situation.
ctx.gift: Your gift is powerful intuition and psychic sensitivity. You can perceive what others miss and navigate uncertainty by feeling. Trust your dreams and instincts; they are a profound source of wisdom and guidance right now.

name: XIX · The Sun
imagery: A naked child with a wreath of flowers and a red feather rides a white horse beneath a blazing sun, holding a large red banner, with tall sunflowers peeking over a grey stone wall behind. The child's innocence and nakedness show nothing left to hide, the white horse speaks of purity and strength, and the sunflowers turned toward the light reflect the joy, growth and clarity that come when we live openly in our truth.
meaning: The Sun is one of the most joyful cards in the deck, bringing warmth, success and clear, bright energy. After the confusion of the Moon, everything is illuminated: you know who you are and what you want. Health, vitality and confidence are strong, and your natural radiance draws good things to you. This is a time to celebrate, to play, and to let your inner child run free. Step into the light and let yourself be seen; your joy is a blessing to the world.
numerology: Nineteen, reduced to ten and then to one, marks a joyful completion that becomes a radiant new beginning.
affirmation: I shine my light freely, and joy flows to me.

ctx.past: A bright, successful or joyful period in your past built your confidence and sense of self. Perhaps it was a time of achievement, health or simple happiness. That warmth still nourishes you and reminds you of what is possible.
ctx.present: Right now the sun is shining on you. Things are clear, positive and full of vitality. This is a time to enjoy your success, express yourself openly, and share your happiness. Let yourself fully receive the good that is here.
ctx.future: A joyful, successful outcome is coming. Expect clarity, recognition and a renewed sense of energy and optimism. Whatever you are working toward is moving into the light. Keep your attitude bright and your heart open to receive it.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle may be too much heat: overconfidence, burnout or forced positivity that ignores genuine concerns. Or you may hesitate to shine for fear of being seen. The challenge is to let your light be authentic, warm rather than scorching.
ctx.advice: Embrace joy and visibility. Go outside, soak up the sunlight, and do something purely for fun. Share your work, your feelings and your gifts openly. Approach the situation with a child's curiosity and confidence; optimism is the right medicine now.
ctx.self: You are feeling confident, vital and comfortable in your own skin. Your inner child is happy and free. You see yourself clearly and like what you see, and that self-assurance radiates outward, drawing others to you.
ctx.others: Others see you as warm, successful and full of life. You may be surrounded by cheerful, supportive people or a sunny, encouraging environment. Your openness and enthusiasm are inspiring those around you, and doors may open simply because people enjoy your company.
ctx.hopes: You hope for happiness, success and a life full of light. Perhaps you fear that such joy cannot last. The Sun reassures you that this happiness is real and that you deserve it. Let yourself believe in good things.
ctx.love: In love, the Sun brings happiness, warmth and openness. Relationships flourish with laughter, honesty and shared joy. It can signal commitment, a happy partnership, or even new life. Singles shine brightly and attract genuine, uplifting connections.
ctx.work: In work and finances, success, recognition and prosperity are favoured. Projects come to fruition, efforts are rewarded, and confidence opens doors. Creative work shines especially brightly. This is an excellent time to promote yourself and step into leadership.
ctx.spirit: Spirit pours down blessings and solar energy. Your guides celebrate with you and encourage you to recognise the divine light within. Sun magic, midsummer rituals and gratitude practices are especially powerful now. You are walking in the light.
ctx.release: Release self-doubt, false modesty and the habit of dimming your light to make others comfortable. Let go of heaviness and gloom that no longer reflects your reality. Stepping fully into joy is its own act of liberation.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath the surface may be a radiant part of yourself you have been afraid to show, or a playful inner child waiting to be seen. Bringing that hidden light into the open will warm every area of your life.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies genuine vitality, clarity and goodwill. Beneath any surface concern is a solid base of optimism and strength. Building on this sunny foundation ensures that what grows above it will flourish.
ctx.gift: Your gift is radiant joy and the power to uplift others. Your warmth, confidence and openness are magnetic. This is a time when your natural light can bring healing and happiness to everyone you touch.

name: XX · Judgement
imagery: The archangel Gabriel blows a trumpet hung with a red-crossed banner from the clouds, and below, men, women and children rise from open coffins floating on water, arms raised toward the sky. Snow-capped mountains stand in the distance. The trumpet is a call to awaken, the rising figures show rebirth and liberation from the past, and the cross on the banner marks the meeting of spirit and matter in a moment of profound renewal.
meaning: Judgement sounds a call that you can no longer ignore: it is time to rise into a new level of awareness. This card speaks of spiritual awakening, self-evaluation and absolution, of reviewing your life honestly, forgiving what needs forgiving, and answering your true calling. Old chapters are laid to rest so you can step forward renewed. A decision made now reflects the deepest truth of who you are becoming. Listen for the trumpet in your heart and rise to meet it.
numerology: Twenty, reduced to two, speaks of the union of the human and the divine, and of answering a call from beyond oneself.
affirmation: I answer my calling, and I rise renewed.

ctx.past: In the past a moment of awakening or reckoning changed the course of your life. Perhaps you made peace with something, or heard a calling and answered it. That turning point still shapes who you are and the purpose you carry.
ctx.present: Right now you are being called to rise. A moment of clarity, decision or reckoning is here. Take stock honestly of your life, forgive yourself and others where you can, and listen to the inner voice urging you toward your true path.
ctx.future: An awakening, important decision or renewal lies ahead. You may receive news or reach a realisation that changes your perspective. Prepare to answer the call with courage; this is a chance to step into a more authentic version of your life.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle may be harsh self-judgement or reluctance to answer an inner calling. You may be replaying past mistakes instead of forgiving them, or ignoring a summons out of fear. The challenge is to evaluate yourself honestly without condemnation, then rise.
ctx.advice: Take time for honest self-reflection. Review where you have been, release guilt, and decide what you truly want next. Then act decisively. Listen for the message that keeps repeating itself in your life; it is your call to awaken.
ctx.self: You are in a process of awakening, seeing yourself more clearly than ever before. There is a sense of being called to something greater. Trust this inner stirring; you are becoming who you were always meant to be.
ctx.others: Others may be evaluating you, or someone may bring a message that acts as your wake-up call. A community or circle may be gathering around a shared purpose. Be open to the voices that remind you of your potential.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a fresh start, a sense of purpose, or forgiveness for the past. Perhaps you fear being judged or failing to live up to your calling. The trumpet sounds for you; you are worthy of this rebirth.
ctx.love: In love, Judgement brings a reckoning and renewal. Couples may reassess their bond and choose each other again with fresh clarity, or old wounds are forgiven at last. For singles, a significant awakening about what you truly want in love is underway.
ctx.work: In work and craft, a calling is making itself heard. This may be the moment to pursue a vocation, make a major career decision, or return to a long-neglected path. Evaluations, results and important decisions are highlighted; trust what you know about yourself.
ctx.spirit: Spirit sounds the trumpet of awakening. Your ancestors and guides are calling you to remember who you are and step into your spiritual purpose. This is a powerful time for initiation, rededication and rituals of rebirth and release.
ctx.release: Release guilt, shame and the weight of past mistakes. Let the old coffins open and empty. Forgive yourself and others, and lay to rest what no longer belongs to the person you are becoming. You are free to rise.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath the surface may be a calling you have been quietly ignoring, or a harsh inner critic that keeps you from rising. Acknowledging it allows the awakening to complete and transforms judgement into compassion.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is a call to awaken, a deep need for renewal and truth. Something in your soul is asking to be reborn. Honouring that core summons brings meaning and direction to everything built upon it.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the capacity for profound renewal and clear self-knowledge. You can hear the deeper call and rise to answer it. This awakening brings forgiveness, purpose and the power to begin again with wisdom.

name: XXI · The World
imagery: A dancing figure, wrapped in a flowing violet sash and holding a wand in each hand, moves within a large oval laurel wreath bound with red ribbons. In the four corners appear an angel, an eagle, a lion and a bull, the fixed signs and the four elements. The wreath symbolises victory and completion, the twin wands balance active and receptive forces, and the four creatures show that all elements are in harmony at the end of the Fool's journey.
meaning: The World marks completion, wholeness and the triumphant end of a major cycle. Everything has come together: the lessons are learned, the journey is complete, and you stand in your full power. This is a time of fulfilment, celebration and well-earned recognition. It can also signal travel, expansion, and a sense of being at home in the wider world. Dance in the circle you have created, honour all you have become, and know that each completion opens the next great adventure.
numerology: Twenty-one, reduced to three, is creation fulfilled; as the final Major it brings the journey full circle back to the Fool.
affirmation: I am whole, complete, and ready for my next great journey.

ctx.past: A major cycle reached completion in your past. You achieved something significant, integrated important lessons, or reached a sense of wholeness. That accomplishment forms a strong base, and you carry its wisdom into everything you do now.
ctx.present: Right now a chapter is coming to a successful close. You are reaping the fruits of your journey and experiencing integration, fulfilment and harmony. Pause to celebrate how far you have come before stepping into what is next.
ctx.future: Completion and fulfilment are on their way. A long-term goal is likely to be achieved, bringing a deep sense of satisfaction and wholeness. New horizons, possibly including travel or expansion, open once this cycle is complete.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle may be difficulty finishing, letting a cycle close, or feeling that you are never quite done. Perhaps you are chasing perfection when completion is enough. The challenge is to tie up loose ends and allow yourself to arrive.
ctx.advice: Finish what you started and celebrate it fully. Tie up the loose ends, honour your achievements, and integrate the lessons before moving on. Mark the ending with a ritual or gathering, then look toward the wider world with open arms.
ctx.self: You feel whole, accomplished and at peace with yourself. All the parts of who you are seem to be working in harmony. You have grown into your power and can dance freely in the life you have built.
ctx.others: Others recognise your achievements and see you as complete and capable. You may be part of a wider community or global network that supports you. The environment around you reflects harmony and success, and people are ready to celebrate alongside you.
ctx.hopes: You hope for completion, recognition and a sense of belonging in the world. You may fear that the journey will never end or that you will never feel whole. The World assures you that fulfilment is within reach.
ctx.love: In love, the World brings harmony, commitment and a sense of completeness together. Relationships may reach a significant milestone, and partners feel deeply at home with each other. For singles, feeling whole within yourself attracts a truly fulfilling connection.
ctx.work: In work and finances, major goals are achieved and projects come to successful completion. Recognition, rewards and international or far-reaching opportunities are favoured. Your craft has reached mastery; this is the moment to celebrate and then expand your vision.
ctx.spirit: Spirit celebrates your completion of a great cycle of growth. You are in harmony with all four elements and the cosmic dance itself. Your guides honour your journey and remind you that every ending is also the doorway to a new beginning.
ctx.release: Release the chapter that is complete. Let go of the need to keep striving when you have already arrived. Close the circle gracefully, honour what it gave you, and free yourself to begin the next journey unburdened.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath the surface may be a reluctance to accept that you have succeeded, or fear of what comes after completion. Acknowledging your own wholeness allows you to fully receive the fulfilment you have earned.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a cycle of growth that has come full circle. The foundation is integration and earned wisdom. Building on this sense of wholeness ensures that the next chapter rests on mastery rather than striving.
ctx.gift: Your gift is wholeness, mastery and the ability to bring things to fruition. You hold all the elements in balance and know how to complete what you begin. This fulfilment radiates outward, inspiring and uniting others.
